title: Silver Peacock for Best Actor (Female) Awarded to Maya O’Rourke for ‘The Meltdown'
subtitle:
Jury recognises the actress for a portrayal that invites audiences to explore the mysteries of cinema
Citation applauds the extraordinary synergy between Maya O’Rourke’s performance and director Manuela Martelli’s vision
body_text:
Posted On: 28 NOV 2026 8:11PM by PIB Mumbai Release ID: 2343216 Views: 89 A A Print Share X Facebook Instagram WhatsApp Copy Article Link
Read in: English Urdu Gujarati Marathi हिन्दी Malayalam
Goa, 28 November 2026 Maya O’Rourke has been awarded the Silver Peacock for Best Actor (Female) for her performance in ‘The Meltdown’, directed by Manuela Martelli, at the 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI). The award was presented by Shri. Pramod Sawant, Chief Minister of Goa, in the presence of Shri Chanchal Kumar, Secretary, Ministry of Information & Broadcasting, and Shri. Ashutosh Gowarikar, Festival Director, IFFI. Recognising a performance that leaves a lasting impression through its depth and artistic impact, the jury commended Maya O’Rourke for bringing a captivating presence to the screen. The jury’s citation reads: “For a captivating performance that awakens curiosity and invites us to explore the mysteries of cinema, elevated by the extraordinary synergy between the actress and the director's exceptional vision”. Through this recognition, Maya O’Rourke joins the artists whose work has made this year's competition a celebration of exceptional cinematic talent. The Silver Peacock for Best Actor (Female) comprises the Peacock trophy, a certificate and a cash prize of ₹15 lakhs. Synopsis of The Meltdown Set in 1992, in Chile’s remote Andean ski resort, the story follows nine-year-old Inès, who is staying at her grandparents’ hotel. She befriends Hanna, a 15-year-old German skier. When Hanna suddenly disappears, the search to find her reveals secrets and hidden truths. IFFI 2026: Best Actor (Female)
